newsitem.title: FRANCE: SOCCER-FEAR OF FLYING WILL NOT HAMPER BERGKAMP.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-FEAR OF FLYING WILL NOT HAMPER BERGKAMP.

text.p: Fear of flying will not hamper Dutch forward Dennis Bergkamp's international career.
A source close to the Arsenal player said Bergkamp would be able to fulfil all bar one of his country's forthcoming international commitments despite his well-publicised fear of flying.
The source said Bergkamp would miss the Netherlands' group seven World Cup qualifier in Turkey but would be able to travel by land to the other qualifier in San Marino.
He would also be able to attend all World Cup finals matches and all games in the 2000 European championships which the Netherlands is co-hosting with Belgium.
Bergkamp will retire from international soccer after Euro 2000 when he will be 32, the source added.
